item.title: Execution Engine
item.description:
Execution Engine Deep Dive

The FlexiRule Execution Engine is a deterministic graph executor designed for reliability, observability, and safety.

Execution Lifecycle

1. Triggering

Execution starts when the RuleCoordinator receives an event.

item.title: Condition System
item.description:
Condition System Architecture

FlexiRule employs a sophisticated, high-performance condition system that allows users to build complex logic visually while executing it with the speed and safety of native Python.

item.title: Trigger System
item.description:
Trigger System

The FlexiRule Trigger System determines when a rule should begin its execution. It is managed by the RuleCoordinator, which acts as a high-performance dispatcher integrated into the Frappe lifecycle.

item.title: Orchestration
item.description:
Orchestration Capabilities

FlexiRule is more than a simple automation engine; it is a Visual Orchestration Layer that allows for the coordination of complex business processes across multiple DocTypes and systems.
